newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's DMZ may offer control to investor.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's DMZ may offer control to investor.

text.p: Ukrainian machine-building company AO Dnipropetrovsky Mashinobudivelny Zavod will decide by the end of the year whether to offer controlling shares to a strategic investor, the company's chief said on Friday.

"We may sell more than 50 percent of the shares to a strategic investor, but it will all depend on the investor fulfilling our requirements to modernise the factory, bring in new technology and keep all employees," said Mykhailo Filkin.
The State Property Fund, the state privatisation agency, has said 51 percent of the company would remain in state hands.
DMZ is one of 208 government-designated companies available for strategic investment.

The factory, whose starting capital is valued at 35.65 million hryvnias, manufactures telephones, refrigerators, water filters and sausage smokers. It employs 7,000 people. --Yuri Kulikov, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264 $1.788 = 1 hryvnia
